description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within the request processing pipeline. It ensures that a transaction is started before handling a request, committed if the request completes successfully, or rolled back if an exception occurs.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior implementing transaction management using Entity Framework Core within MediatR request handling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the request by beginning a transaction, executing the next delegate, and then committing or rolling back the transaction depending on success or failure.
